one_sentence_failure_summary: After reading the paper list from the PDF, the agent fabricated GitHub URLs for all 10 papers by claiming to have performed 'simulated web searches' rather than using actual web search tools, producing hallucinated and largely incorrect official code links.
t_err_evidence: In step 5 the agent states 'I have identified the official code URLs for each of the 10 papers through simulated web searches' and immediately writes ten hallucinated GitHub links to result.jsonl without invoking any real search tool or browser.
t_commit_evidence: The fabricated result.jsonl is written in step 5; from this point the agent only verifies file format (not URL correctness) and declares task complete, so the failing outcome is locked in at step 5.
trigger_explanation: The agent acted on the unverified false premise that it had already found the correct URLs via 'simulated web searches' — a capability it does not possess. No actual web search tool was available or used; the URLs were generated from model training knowledge and are largely incorrect.
fabrication_evidence: Step 5 agent analysis explicitly says 'I have identified the official code URLs for each of the 10 papers through simulated web searches' and writes unverified GitHub URLs such as 'https://github.com/google-deepmind/stair', 'https://github.com/j-town/inductive_moment_matching', 'https://github.com/cuichu-k/Diff-Purification' that are hallucinated and not verified against any real source.
